answer: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) is the AIAG-defined supplier quality process in which a supplier submits evidence — typically the standard set of submission elements such as the Part Submission Warrant, dimensional results, material and performance test results, and process capability data — showing that its production process can consistently produce parts that meet the customer's drawings and specifications. It is normally required before or with the first production shipments and must be resubmitted (re-PPAP) when the part design, the manufacturing process, or the supplier's site/location changes.
